instruction: Today is my son's birthday. Venmo him four times the money I sent him on his last birthday, privately, with a description note, "Have a great day!". Then leave him a phone text message, "Happy Birthday son! Hope you have a great day!".
notes: Two apps (phone, venmo) plus supervisor. The son's email and phone number are discovered via phone.search_contacts filtered by relationship 'son'. Since today (2023-05-18) is his birthday, last birthday is 2022-05-18, so venmo.show_transactions is filtered by user_email, direction=sent and that date window; the found amount is the 'amount-last-birthday' object and the static (four-times ...) fact links it to the 4x amount actually sent. Ordering 'then' is enforced: the text can only be sent after (birthday-gift-sent son). supervisor.complete_task carries only record parameters (no API answer) and is forced last via (not (task-completed)) on every action; its precondition equals the task-specific goal conjuncts. Evaluation requires exactly one new private venmo transaction with description 'Have a great day!' and one new text message with the given content.

plan: (venmo-show-transactions phone-token son-email direction-sent datetime-2022-05-18t00-00-00 datetime-2022-05-18t23-59-59 son amount-last-birthday)
(venmo-create-transaction son-email amount-four-times-last-birthday phone-token note-have-a-great-day privacy-private son amount-last-birthday)
